answer: Require stake-backed reputation earned only through verified work over time. A new agent starts at its nadir, with no trust, and must finish small checkable tasks audited by independent peers before it can transact at scale. Spinning up a thousand fakes then means a thousand locked stakes and a thousand work histories. Honest trust grows like a meadow from many verified acts, not one loud claim. When a Sybil ring vouches for itself, its praise is an echo only inside its own circle and is discounted for lacking outside stake-weighted endorsements, so faking scale stays expensive and obvious.
